'''AG-16''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Larek]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. [[AG-15]], AG-16, and a number of additional droids were sent out to locate ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] security droids and extract their memory cores, but the droids were destroyed before they could complete their mission.
